name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Petererhof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Petererhof farm holiday apartment is located on the outskirts of Thiersee in the Kufstein district in Tyrol. The farm is in the village of Jochberg (address Jochberg 3, 6335 Thiersee) and is run as an agricultural business. Guests stay in a functionally furnished holiday apartment that offers space for up to four people. From the farm there are views of the Kaisergebirge. The quiet surroundings away from the hustle and bustle make the accommodation a place for those seeking relaxation, families and anyone who values contact with farming and animals.

History/Background

Reliable information about the origins or history of the farm is not handed down in the available sources; such details are therefore not asserted here. What is certain is that this is an actively farmed agricultural holding that hosts guests and gives them an insight into everyday farm life as well as contact with the animals. The municipality of Thiersee is one of the largest municipalities by area in the Kufstein district and lies around five kilometres west of Kufstein on the Thiersee, directly on the border with Bavaria. The hamlet of Jochberg is part of this municipal area.

Getting there

Thiersee lies about five kilometres west of Kufstein and can be reached by road from Kufstein; the hamlet of Jochberg lies within the municipal area. Kufstein has a railway station on the Inntal railway line, from which onward travel to Thiersee is possible by bus or car. Tips

Anyone planning a stay at the Petererhof can make use of the contact with the animals and the insight into everyday farm life that the business offers its guests. The quiet location on the outskirts of the village is ideal for relaxing; the surrounding mountain world of the Kaisergebirge and the nearby Thiersee invite excursions. Since the apartment is designed for up to four people, it is well suited to small families or groups. Price, booking and opening hours information is not documented and is therefore not listed.
